sources.note: equipment plan source (research grade: datasheet); size 482.6 x 508 x 177.8 mm (w x d x h); port and control positions are placeholders until measured

Omnia.11 manual, installation chapter, opened 2026-11-12 (read through the fetch tool): four EIA rack spaces, rear panel with analog XLR in and out (left and right), AES in, AES out 1 and 2, AES sync in, a composite AES out, four BNCs (composite 1 and 2, 19 kHz, SCA in), two RJ-45 (the top jack carries remote control and Livewire I/O, the bottom jack is "not fully implemented"), two DB-9 serial ports, one DB-15 GPI, and an EMI-filtered IEC male power inlet (type letter not named: iec-c14 assumed, plan assumedConnectors power-in). The manual states "There is no power switch": the `power` control of the catalogue entry is the simulator toggle for the unit being powered, drawn as a rocker next to the inlet only because the template requires one per mains inlet. Not modelled: AES sync in, composite AES out, BNCs, DB-9, DB-15 (no signal type or not audio). Generic artwork only (content/generic-panels/<id>.json, drawn by npm run asset:panel): connectors, knobs and indicators drawn at the port positions, no photo, no logo, no lettering. Every port and control position is a guess (confidence guess): no drawing or photo was opened. Connector genders not stated by the source follow the convention input = female, output = male.

Omnia.11 appendix A performance specifications, opened 2026-11-12: 19 in x 7 in x 20 in (W x H x D) including connectors (482.6 x 177.8 x 508 mm), shipping weight 36 lb. The Telos "Performance Specifications" page that lists 2U 482 x 428 x 86 mm belongs to another product.
